title: Thozhan
subtitle: Fair, transparent rides for Tamil Nadu
narration: Vanakkam. This is Thozhan, a mobility platform built for Tamil Nadu. In five minutes we will show how it works, how it earns revenue, and what it offers the government, the public and drivers.

title: The problem today
bullets: Street-hail auto fares are often negotiated, not metered
Commission-based apps take a share of every fare from drivers
Little public data on whether notified fares are followed
Most ride apps are designed English first
narration: Today, street-hail auto fares are often negotiated. Commission apps take a share of every fare from drivers. Officials have little data on whether notified fares are followed. And most apps are English first.

title: One platform, four services
narration: Thozhan brings autos, bike taxis, cabs and parcel delivery onto one platform, with one fare engine and one safety system. Each service switches on only after its legal approval. Bike taxis stay off until the state confirms the rules.

title: Fares come straight from the Government Order
narration: Every auto fare comes straight from Government Order three sixty six of October twenty twenty six. Fifty rupees for the first one point eight kilometres, twenty five rupees per additional kilometre, one rupee per waiting minute, one and a half times at night, and separate ghat road rates. The tariff is stored as data, so a revision needs no new code.

title: Tamil first, English always
narration: The whole app works in Tamil and English. Tamil is the default, and one tap switches language. Every screen and receipt is translated.

title: Choose pickup, drop and vehicle
narration: Step one. The passenger picks a pickup and destination, here Chennai Central to T. Nagar. Every vehicle shows its fare upfront. The auto is marked government tariff. Cab fares are labelled illustrative, and the bike taxi shows it awaits permission.

title: An itemised fare, with its legal source
narration: Step two. Fare details show exactly how the price is built, and quote the Government Order. Where the order is silent, such as on rounding, the app says so openly.

title: Request sent, with a secure start OTP
narration: Step three. The passenger books, and receives a four digit start code. The trip cannot begin until the driver enters it. Trip sharing and safety help are one tap away.

title: The driver accepts the request
narration: Step four. The driver sees the route, distance and full fare before accepting. No hidden deductions.

title: Start only with the passenger's OTP
narration: Step five. At pickup, the driver enters the passenger's code. Only then does the trip start. A wrong code is rejected.

title: Trip complete: earnings and a ₹10 day fee
narration: Step six. When the trip ends, earnings update at once. There is zero commission. Just a ten rupee fee, once a day, only after the first completed trip.

title: The virtual auto meter for street hails
narration: Now, a feature built for Tamil Nadu: the virtual auto meter. A passenger who stops an auto on the street opens the meter, optionally enters the registration number, and presses start.

title: Live fare from GPS, under the Government Order
narration: GPS measures distance and waiting time, and the live fare follows the same government tariff, with optional Tamil voice. Bad GPS readings are filtered, and fake locations are flagged.

title: Receipt, and one-tap overcharge report
narration: At the end, the passenger gets an itemised Tamil receipt. If the driver asks for more, one tap reports it, with the metered fare as evidence.

title: Send a parcel by bike or auto
narration: Thozhan also delivers parcels by bike or auto, with weight limits and restricted items shown clearly, and the price upfront.

title: Two OTPs: one at pickup, one at delivery
narration: Each parcel has two codes: the sender's for pickup, and the receiver's for delivery. One cannot replace the other.

title: Fare compliance and service switches
narration: The operations console shows every journey, and fare compliance in aggregate: meter trips, overcharge reports, and how far asked fares exceeded the meter. No personal data needed. Services switch on or off by approval status.

title: Fare check: verify any trip in seconds
narration: For officials, the fare check page shows the official fare for any trip, line by line. Five kilometres with six minutes of waiting by day is one hundred thirty six rupees. The same engine runs everywhere, so what officials verify is what passengers pay.

title: Revenue model: ₹10 per active day, zero commission
titleTa: வருவாய் மாதிரி: செயல்படும் நாளுக்கு ₹10, கமிஷன் இல்லை
narration: The revenue model. No percentage of fares. Each driver pays ten rupees on a day they complete a trip. An illustrative driver earning twelve hundred rupees would lose two hundred forty to a twenty percent commission. With Thozhan, just ten.

title: How the ₹10 model scales
narration: At twenty five paid days a month, two thousand drivers bring five lakh rupees a month, and twenty thousand bring fifty lakh. With illustrative costs, break even is about nineteen hundred drivers. These gross figures will be validated in the pilot. Parcels and corporate accounts can add more.

title: Benefits for the government
bullets: Notified tariffs applied automatically, updated as data
Aggregate fare-compliance data, without personal data
Overcharge complaints with GPS evidence
A digital meter for every auto, including street hails
Services enabled only after approval
narration: For the government: notified tariffs applied automatically, aggregate compliance data without personal data, overcharge complaints with GPS evidence, a digital meter for every auto, and no service without approval.

title: Benefits for the public
bullets: The government fare, shown upfront
No more bargaining on the street
Tamil-first app with itemised receipts
Trip OTP, trip sharing and SOS
Rides and parcels in one app
narration: For the public: the government fare upfront, no bargaining, a Tamil-first app with receipts, trip codes, sharing and S O S, and rides and parcels in one app.

title: Benefits for drivers
bullets: Zero commission: keep the fare you earn
₹10 only on days you earn; nothing on idle days
Full fare visible before accepting
Trusted meter reduces fare disputes
Transparent daily ledger
narration: For drivers: zero commission, a ten rupee fee only on earning days, the full fare before accepting, fewer fare disputes, and a transparent daily ledger.

title: Where we are, and what comes next
narration: Where we stand: this is a working demonstration on a tested fare engine and meter. Next, the secure backend and Android apps, and road testing the meter. Then a controlled Chennai pilot with fifty to one hundred fifty verified drivers, with results published openly.

title: Our request
bullets: Nominate a nodal officer
Clarify aggregator, bike-taxi and cab tariff rules
Permit a bounded Chennai auto pilot
narration: We request a nodal officer, clarity on aggregator, bike taxi and cab tariff rules, and permission for a bounded Chennai pilot. Thozhan means friend. A friend to every passenger, every driver, and every city in Tamil Nadu. Nandri.
